secret.title: Boiled Potato
secret.process: Take 500ml water in the pot. Put the potatos in it and light it in the stove for 7-10 minutes

secret.title: Classic Scrambled Eggs
secret.ingridents: 3 Eggs, 1 tbsp Butter, Salt and Black Pepper to taste
secret.process: Whisk eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt. Melt butter in the pan over medium-low heat. Pour in eggs and gently push them across the pan with a spatula until soft curds form. Remove from heat and season with black pepper.

secret.title: Garlic Butter Pasta
secret.ingridents: 200g Spaghetti, 3 cloves Garlic (minced), 2 tbsp Butter, 1 tbsp Olive Oil, Chili Flakes, Salt
secret.process: Boil spaghetti in salted water until al dente. Heat oil and butter in a pan, add minced garlic and chili flakes, cooking until fragrant. Toss the drained pasta into the garlic butter sauce with a splash of pasta water until well coated.

secret.title: Vegetable Grilled Sandwich
secret.ingridents: 4 Bread Slices, 1 Sliced Tomato, 1 Sliced Cucumber, Butter, Cheese Slices, Oregano
secret.process: Butter the bread slices. Layer tomato and cucumber slices on top, add a cheese slice, and sprinkle oregano. Cover with the second bread slice and grill on a pan until golden brown and crispy on both sides.

secret.title: Oatmeal with Fruit
secret.ingridents: 1 cup Rolled Oats, 2 cups Milk or Water, 1 tbsp Honey, 1 Sliced Banana, Berries
secret.process: Combine oats and milk in a saucepan. Bring to a gentle boil over medium heat, then simmer for 3-5 minutes while stirring. Pour into a bowl, drizzle with honey, and top with banana slices and fresh berries.

secret.title: Pan-Seared Garlic Mushrooms
secret.ingridents: 250g Button Mushrooms (cleaned), 2 tbsp Butter, 2 cloves Garlic (minced), Soy Sauce, Chopped Parsley
secret.process: Melt butter in a skillet over high heat. Add whole or halved mushrooms and sear without stirring for 3 minutes. Add garlic and a splash of soy sauce, tossing for another 3-4 minutes until golden. Garnish with parsley.
